outputs_intentionally_omitted: final-best consensus partitions and co-association matrices
interpretation: ARI/NMI measure agreement between partitions, not biological accuracy.
Final-best comparisons use the selected partition saved for each run.
Cell IDs and their order are checked against the first successful run before comparisons.
The within_run_consensus folder name is retained for workflow continuity; this clean script stores selected-best cell labels there and does not calculate within-run consensus.
A configured LLM seed is best-effort reproducibility, not a guarantee of identical outputs.
